name: The hub filled to its cap, then one more
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: With the line set to start by itself, filling the hub to its 80 owls puts the next visitor in the line with the busy ribbon on, and nobody already inside lags (OP-075, OP-088).
blast_radius: The throwaway park's hub: 70 more scripted visitors beside the fleet's 10, then two more; the line's setting changed for the run and put back.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.
